「Don't go to the hangar」

　making their final move by then.」

stage0083_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:

「Neo Zeon, Mycenae, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, Altair,

stage0083_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$n
「To steel myself for what's coming,
　I should know how things stand
　on every front.」

stage0083_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$n
「I'll be fine, Miss $$スズネ$$.
　I intend to keep fighting until I defeat
　him... $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$.」

stage0083_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$n
「But that's not just to avenge

stage0083_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$n
「More than anything, I have to defeat

stage0083_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:

　there's nothing more your teacher

stage0083_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$n
「...Why are you crossing your arms right there?」

stage0083_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$スズネ$$
「You've gotten quite reliable, $n.
　I thought I'd let you escort me for once.」

stage0083_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Ah... I feel bad for the nurse...」

stage0083_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$n
「It's fine. Miss $$スズネ$$ is our important
　teacher, and she's my partner.」

stage0083_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Well then... take me to the hangar, $n.」

stage0083_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$甲児$$
「We beat the Eighth Angel, but after that,
　$$第９の使徒$$ showed up...」

stage0083_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$甲児$$
「It attached itself to the newly built
　EVA Unit-03 and eroded $$アスカ$$,
　who was the test pilot...」

stage0083_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Was $$アスカ$$ done in by that Angel?」

stage0083_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$アルト$$
「...It had completely fused with Unit-03's
　Entry Plug. The only way to beat it
　was to destroy the plug.」

stage0083_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$アルト$$
「What did it was the Dummy System
　installed in Unit-01... but $$シンジ$$
　was riding in it too.」

stage0083_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$アルト$$
「It's supposedly an autonomous system
　that controls an EVA, but we don't know
　any of the details.」

stage0083_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アルト$$
「NERV's Commander Ikari forcibly activated
　the Dummy System because $$シンジ$$ refused
　to fight $$アスカ$$.」

stage0083_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$甲児$$
「...There was no other choice...
　If things had gone on like that,
　$$シンジ$$ would've been killed by the Angel too...」

stage0083_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Even if that was the only way...」

stage0083_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$甲児$$
「A decisive rift has formed between him
　and Commander Ikari.」

stage0083_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$アルト$$
「And he was almost reconciled
　with his old man for a while, too...」

stage0083_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$甲児$$
「Unit-02 is going to be operated by
　a new pilot now, a girl named
　$$真希波・マリ・イラストリアス$$.」

stage0083_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$アルト$$
「She's a bit odd. Outside of operations,
　she won't try to talk to anyone.
　She told us to just think of her as not there...」

stage0083_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I know it's harsh, but we have to move on.
　$$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ has declared
　annihilation upon humanity once more.」

stage0083_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$甲児$$
「For now, it seems its targets
　are $$シモン$$ and the rest of us.」

stage0083_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$アムロ$$
「We have no choice but to fight...
　We won't accept a slow death in the
　Prison of Time, or being wiped out by anyone.」

stage0083_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$タケル$$
「So, $$オードリー$$ is staying at
　Ensign $$リディ$$'s house right now?」

stage0083_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$リディ$$
「I've left the rest to my father.」

stage0083_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$リディ$$
（My family has been part of Chrono
　for generations... Bringing her to
　that house might only cause her pain...）

stage0083_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$リディ$$
（The only way to save her from that
　is to welcome her into the Marcenas
　family as one of our own...）

stage0083_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$リディ$$
（$$バナージ$$ and Unicorn... and Laplace's
　Box... If that thing didn't exist,
　could $$オードリー$$ and I both be free...）

stage0083_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$正太郎$$
「What's wrong, $$リディ$$...?
　You suddenly look so scary...」

stage0083_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$リディ$$
「Sorry. ...Let me rest in my room
　for a bit.」

stage0083_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$タケル$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$... he's really changed...」

stage0083_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Speaking of changed, $$バナージ$$ has too.」

stage0083_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$バナージ$$
（$$ジンネマン$$, $$ロニ$$...
　and $$オードリー$$...）

stage0083_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$バナージ$$
（What I can do for this world in
　Unicorn... I'll search for
　my own potential...）

stage0083_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$グラハム$$
「He walked the line between life and
　death in the battle over Dakar.」

stage0083_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$フォウ$$
「And he's known a sad parting, too...」

stage0083_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Major $$グラハム・エーカー$$.
　I go by the codename $$プリベンター$$
　Lightning.」

stage0083_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$フォウ$$
「Ensign $$フォウ・ムラサメ$$.
　Like Major $$グラハム$$, I've joined $c
　on Commander $$レディ・アン$$'s orders.」

stage0083_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$タケル$$
「Could it be... you're the one
　$$カミーユ$$ mentioned...?」

stage0083_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$フォウ$$
「Fufu... I don't know how he described me,
　but we've known each other since
　our days in $$ＵＣＷ$$.」

stage0083_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「So, this $$グラハム$$ guy, didn't he wear
　some weird mask during the
　$$再世戦争$$?」

stage0083_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$グラハム$$
「It's embarrassing to say in front of you,
　but that was just youthful folly.」

stage0083_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Well, don't be too hard on him.
　The past is the past, and now is now.」

stage0083_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「My name's Lieutenant $$パトリック・マネキン$$.
　They call me the 'Happy $$コーラサワー$$'.
　Nice to meet you.」

stage0083_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Um... didn't you used to go
　by 'the Undying $$コーラサワー$$'
　before?」

stage0083_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Of course, I'm still Undying.
　But these days, 'Happy' carries
　more weight.」

stage0083_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$グラハム$$
「We too have become members of $c.
　We intend to do everything we can
　for this world.」

stage0083_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$グラハム$$
（So this is the squad with that boy...

stage0083_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$グラハム$$

$n
「...Sorry. Knowing the final battle

　can't sit still.」

stage0083_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:

「Defeating $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$...

「If you understand that much,
　there's nothing more your teacher
　needs to say. ...But don't push yourself too hard.」

stage0083_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「You're training in the Quarter's
　simulator, right? Then I'll bring you
　a sandwich later.」

stage0083_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$... can you even do that?」

stage0083_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$スズネ$$
「How rude...! Sure, seeing $$アルト$$,
　$$甲児$$, and Ikue makes me lose
　my confidence, but...」

stage0083_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Ah... could it be I'm being unfair
　to the nurse...?」

stage0083_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$n
「It's fine. Miss $$スズネ$$ is our important
　teacher, and she's my partner.」

stage0083_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Though I'm not much help in actual combat.」

stage0083_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$n
「But I am looking forward to the sandwiches.」

stage0083_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh, come on!
　That's where you say 'That's not true at all'!」

stage0083_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...According to Dr. $$トライア$$'s report,
　the completion of $$エタニティ・フラット$$ is now
　all but confirmed for November 11th.」

stage0083_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Even deciding to announce it on November 1st
　was a razor-thin call for the $$大統領$$.」

stage0083_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「As long as we beat Geminis and smash the
　Prison of Time before then, or find the
　singularity and turn things around ourselves, that'll do.」

stage0083_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$オットー$$
「But if it comes to that, we'll end up fighting
　$$バアル$$ like space monsters and $$インベーダー#keyword$$.」

stage0083_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「And whether or not the Prison of Time is completed,
　the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ have declared they will
　annihilate humanity on Earth.」

stage0083_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ブライト$$
「What's more, within this next month,
　the likes of Mycenae and $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ will probably
　launch large-scale operations of their own.」

stage0083_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Forces from every region are beginning to
　gather at $$アクシズ$$. $$シャア$$ probably intends
　to force a decisive battle.」

stage0083_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$オットー$$
「So the truce with us was just to buy time?」

stage0083_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「It didn't look that way to me...」

stage0083_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$オットー$$
「Then how do you explain the situation now?
　Or has he given up on the singularity search,
　planning to end the Federation once $$エタニティ・フラット$$'s done?」

stage0083_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「I suppose there's nothing for it but to ask
　$$シャア・アズナブル$$ himself about that.」

stage0083_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Either way, there's no avoiding a fight, is there...」

stage0083_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Apparently $$レディ・アン$$'s command has been
　getting daily requests from Brigadier General
　$$サイガス$$ for $c to join the operation.」

stage0083_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「A request, huh...
　If he had his way, he'd rather just
　seize our forces outright.」

stage0083_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ブライト$$
「But there's no longer any doubt that
　high command intends to attack the colony.」

stage0083_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「It's only a matter of time now, is it...」

stage0083_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「If only we could end this fight ourselves
　before then...」

stage0083_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ブライト$$
「The time for a decisive battle, is it...」

stage0083_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「To prepare for that,
　I've sent $$イアン$$ up into space.」

stage0083_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「You'll find out, in time.」

stage0083_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$オットー$$
「But why did you choose
　$$第３新東京市$$ as our rendezvous point?」

stage0083_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ブライト$$
「It's a request from Neo-DEAVA. Apparently they
　need our cooperation to carry out an experiment
　in Super-Dimensional physics.」

stage0083_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Now that you mention it, Supreme Commander
　$$不動$$ was here in $$第３新東京市$$ too...」

stage0083_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Though I can't read his intentions at all.」

stage0083_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「An experiment in Super-Dimensional physics...
　Does that mean they've found a way to break
　the Prison of Time...」

stage0083_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Are you alone, Chairwoman $$クレア$$?」

stage0083_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$クレア$$
「No... $$不動$$ is making himself at home in the
　hangar, along with the power to break the Prison of Time.」

stage0083_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$木下$$
「Welcome, Supreme Commander $$不動$$, Your Excellency!」

stage0083_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Thank you so much for taking the time to come
　despite your busy schedule!」

stage0083_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$マオ$$
「The ones welcoming us aren't that old guy.
　It's those kids who came with him.」

stage0083_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ランカ$$
「Sounds like you've been through a lot, $$シモン$$...」

stage0083_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$シモン$$
「Thanks, Ms. $$ランカ$$.
　But I'm fine.」

stage0083_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$シモン$$
「What I need to do is already decided.
　All that's left is to give it everything I've got.」

stage0083_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ランカ$$
「You've gotten stronger...
　Maybe I should call you Mr. $$シモン$$ after all?」

stage0083_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$シモン$$
「Don't worry about that.
　To me, Ms. $$ランカ$$ will always be my idol.」

stage0083_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$シェリル$$
「You'd better do your best too, $$アンディ$$.
　We're fellow hole-diggers, after all.」

stage0083_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$アンディ$$
「You don't need to tell me twice, $$シェリル$$.
　I'll definitely save $$ＭＩＸ$$ myself.」

stage0083_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$シェリル$$
「I'm counting on you, digging duo.
　Go ahead and punch a hole through the dimensional wall too.」

stage0083_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ランカ$$
「Sorry, $$アルト$$.
　We always show up so suddenly.」

stage0083_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$アルト$$
「That's fine, but you're saying that you and
　$$シェリル$$ are the power to break the Prison of Time...」

stage0083_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$不動$$
「You don't understand, $$早乙女アルト$$?
　Then listen well.」

stage0083_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$不動$$
「A song is not merely a vibration of air.」

stage0083_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$不動$$
「Transcending time, transcending place,
　that which moves every soul is what's called a true song...」

stage0083_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アルト$$
「You're going to use the dimension-crossing songs of
　$$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$, and $$バサラ$$ to break the Prison of Time?」

stage0083_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$不動$$
「If it works out, so much the better.」

stage0083_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「I see.
　So you brought $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$-chan to
　$c to combine the three of their voices.」

stage0083_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「What's that supposed to mean?」

stage0083_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「A song is feeling...
　So to maximize those two's feelings,
　you need $$アルト$$, is that it?」

stage0083_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$不動$$
「As expected of you, $$ガムリン・木崎$$.
　You understand song and feeling well.」

stage0083_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Supreme Commander $$不動$$...
　That line, 'A song is not merely a vibration of air'...
　that's a saying passed down since long ago in our world.」

stage0083_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「Where did you hear that?」

stage0083_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$アルト$$
（$$シェリル$$, $$ランカ$$...
　Looks like the world might be saved by you two again.）

stage0083_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$オズマ$$
「I'm counting on you to protect $$ランカ$$ and $$シェリル$$.
　That's why I've prepared the YF-29 for you.」

stage0083_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$オズマ$$
「It's also equipped with a Super Pack to boost
　its mobility. Show me you can handle it.」

stage0083_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Are you thinking back to your fight with Ribbons Almark?」

stage0083_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$刹那$$
「And what happened with $$グレイス$$ O'Connor, too.」

stage0083_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Feelings become strength...
　You must have felt that in that battle too.」

stage0083_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Have you stopped being able to believe that?」

stage0083_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$刹那$$
「I... can't understand $$シャア・アズナブル$$...」

stage0083_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If you don't try to understand him, of course you can't.」

stage0083_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$カイエン$$
「...But, Supreme Commander $$不動$$...
　when did you manage to make contact with
　$$ランカ・リー$$ and $$シェリル・ノーム$$?」

stage0083_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$不動$$
「I don't wander around aimlessly for nothing.」

stage0083_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$シュレード$$
「What do you mean by that?」

stage0083_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「T-that's the legendary being,
　the one with power enough to create a world, right!?」

stage0083_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$カイエン$$
「And that's supposedly here, in this world...」

stage0083_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$不動$$
「Where are $$アマタ・ソラ$$ and $$ミコノ・スズシロ$$?」

stage0083_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「It's free time right now, so I think they're outside.」

stage0083_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$不動$$
「Those who are drawn to each other...
　Something's going to happen today, after all...」

stage0083_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$不動$$
「And drawn along with them, a pitiful avenger comes too.」

stage0083_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「It's hard to believe this planet's
　time is about to stop.」

stage0083_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「You've just been saying 'yeah' this whole time, $$アマタ$$.」

stage0083_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$アマタ$$
「...Like Ms. $$ミコノ$$ says,
　sometimes I can't believe the world's in danger either...」

stage0083_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$アマタ$$
「But in reality, a war is happening,
　the Prison of Time is being completed bit by bit,
　and $$バアル$$ and the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ keep attacking us.」

stage0083_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「...We can't look away from that, can we...」

stage0083_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$アマタ$$
「So, Ms. $$ミコノ$$...
　I think I need to face the truth head-on too.」

stage0083_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミコノ$$, tell me.
　What's your relationship with that beast of a
　guy from Altair?」

stage0083_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$アマタ$$
「It's fine if you don't know.
　But tell me everything you feel about him.」

stage0083_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I want to know...!
　Why that guy calls you $$シルフィ$$!」

stage0083_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I should have the right to hear it too.」

stage0083_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You there, the other half.
　Isn't it about time you woke up?」

stage0083_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Fufu... then let me wake you up.
　...Now, $$カグラ$$.」

stage0083_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Time we settled this, coward $$アマタ$$.」

stage0083_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You... how do you know my name...!?」

stage0083_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I remembered.
　About you... and about me!」

stage0083_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Still can't remember?
　That day in your childhood...
　the day you lost your mother, $$アリシア$$.」

stage0083_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$カグラ$$
「You couldn't do a damn thing, coward $$アマタ$$...!
　That's why I split from you!」

stage0083_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「I... I have to apologize...
　I... I did something horrible... to him...」

stage0083_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Wait for me, $$シルフィ$$!
　I'll kill coward $$アマタ$$ right now and come get you!」

stage0083_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I don't give up on what matters to me!
　I'll chase it to the ends of the earth!!」

stage0083_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Remember, coward $$アマタ$$!
　You are me!」

stage0083_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「You mean the same person from parallel worlds!?」

stage0083_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That's not it.
　That day... the boy who lost his mother
　split himself in two.」

stage0083_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And that other half of the boy
　crossed over to Altair.
　That's him... $$カグラ$$.」

stage0083_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Well then, $$カグラ$$... I'll leave the rest to you.
　In answer to your souls, it will soon revive.」

stage0083_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$カグラ$$
「You're me...
　No wonder you had no scent from when we first met.
　It's the same scent as mine...!」

stage0083_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$カグラ$$
「You and I were originally one person.
　That is... until that day.」

stage0083_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$カグラ$$
「That day, all $$アマタ$$ could do was watch fate go by...
　That's you.」

stage0083_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Guess nothing's changed.
　Can't do a thing when it counts, coward $$アマタ$$!」

stage0083_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Then what about you!?
　You went all the way to Altair chasing Mom,
　so what were you doing there!?」

stage0083_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Crossing dimensions was fine,
　but I got separated from Mom...
　That's where I met $$ミカゲ$$, and got the name $$カグラ$$.」

stage0083_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$カグラ$$
「I lost my memory, and $$ミカゲ$$ raised me.
　I don't care about my mother anymore.
　Same as some father I don't even know!」

stage0083_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$カグラ$$
「There's only one scent that matters to me...!
　The scent of my darling damn woman...!
　The real $$シルフィ$$, and no one else!」

stage0083_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I'm not a coward!
　I won't hand $$ミコノ$$ over to you!!」

stage0083_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「You...!
　Get away from $$アマタ$$!!」

stage0083_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$カグラ$$
「Pathetic, coward $$アマタ$$!
　Needing a woman to save you!?」

stage0083_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$カグラ$$
「What's wrong, $$アマタ$$!?
　Show me you're not a coward!」

stage0083_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「Stop it!
　Why are you two fighting!?
　Please, just stoooop it already!!」

stage0083_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミコノ$$, $$ゼシカ$$!
　Run, now, while you can!!」

stage0083_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Did you come to get in my way?」

stage0083_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$カヲル$$
「That's not my intention.
　But I won't let you touch this.」

stage0083_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Fufu... something that creates a world...」

stage0083_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「No wonder I could never find it,
　no matter how I searched.
　Drawn here by something of the same nature...」

stage0083_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I can really feel that this is the edge of myth.」

stage0083_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$カヲル$$
「I've confirmed your intent, so I'll be going.」

stage0083_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$カヲル$$
「But I... don't think I could ever like you.」

stage0083_03:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「If you have no business here, you may leave.」

stage0083_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh... one who seeks to open the door.
　I offer you my respect.」

stage0083_03:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It seems I'm disliked...
　I'll be on my way, then.」

stage0083_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「If you're going to open the door, hurry.
　This world will end soon.」

stage0083_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミコノ$$...!
　And everyone else, too...!」

stage0083_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$不動$$
「Truth isn't only what the eye can see.
　This is a universe beyond time and space...」

stage0083_03:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$$不動$$
「That's right... this is inside the 'Book of Genesis'...」

stage0083_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$モロイ$$
「The past and future... a book said to record
　every truth of the world...」

stage0083_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$クレア$$
「You're all here, Elements...
　I have something important to tell you all now.」

stage0083_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$不動$$
「What I'm about to tell spans 12,000 years...
　and an ancient myth handed down from
　the 12,000 years before even that...」

stage0083_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$不動$$
「And it goes further back than that...
　all the way to 120,000,000 years ago.」

stage0083_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「12,000 years before
　another 12,000 years ago...?」

stage0083_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「120,000,000 years ago...
　I can't even imagine it...!」

stage0083_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$不動$$
「This book has always been with you.
　A steadfast book, unmoved even by the vast flow of time...」

stage0083_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$ミコノ$$
（$$不動$$...
　The same as our Supreme Commander...）

stage0083_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$不動$$
「Its name is the 'Book of Twin Stars'...!
　And now... unsealed!」

stage0083_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$不動$$
「$c must be seeing this vision too.
　And their final seal will be undone as well.」

stage0083_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$クレア$$
「Time goes back to as far as 24,000 years ago.」

stage0083_03:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$クレア$$
「The 《$$堕天翅$$》 race, one might call
　humanity's natural enemy. Countless defeats,
　countless deaths... The creeping footsteps of ruin...」

stage0083_03:r_38f89a2d27debb9e.text:
$$クレア$$
「That's right... Apollonius, the Wing of Slaughter...」

stage0083_03:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$クレア$$
「The war between humans and the $$堕天翅$$ race...
　By some trick of fate, one love gave birth
　to a miracle there.」

stage0083_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$クレア$$
「Of all things, Apollonius fell in love
　with a human woman, his supposed enemy,
　Celiane.」

stage0083_03:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$クレア$$
「And so, the Mechanical Angel that Apollonius wielded
　drove back the $$堕天翅$$ and protected
　his beloved Celiane and humankind to the end」

stage0083_03:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$クレア$$
「It is what we call the Mythical Aquarion」

stage0083_03:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「Aquarion was piloted by both a human
　and a $$堕天翅$$...!」

stage0083_03:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$クレア$$
「But where there is light, there is also darkness.
　$$頭翅$$, the $$堕天翅$$ who was Apollonius's
　betrothed, came to hate him for his betrayal」

stage0083_03:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$クレア$$
「And there was one more, a small thing
　seeking light in the darkness...」

stage0083_03:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$アンディ$$
「What's with that dog...!?
　Is that a $$堕天翅$$'s pet!?」

stage0083_03:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$クレア$$
「That was Polon, the wing dog who served
　Apollonius. Of all things, he fell into
　unrequited love with Celiane, his master's beloved」

stage0083_03:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$クレア$$
「Poor Polon prayed to the darkness of night,
　wishing that if he were ever reborn,
　he might be united with Celiane」

stage0083_03:r_8246cdac0973a25f.text:
$$クレア$$
「$$頭翅$$'s hatred, Polon's wish...
　time flows on heartlessly, leaving
　all these feelings behind」

stage0083_03:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$クレア$$
「The shadow of the dead, the pain of the living,
　the joy of darkness, the delight of light...
　let's wrap them all as one in pretty lace...」

stage0083_03:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$クレア$$
「The light of day is life, the dark of night is death...
　they melt together into chaos, and then...」

stage0083_03:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$不動$$
「Open your eyes!
　From here begins the second chapter of the myth!」

stage0083_03:r_1608d4c4d3f78b24.text:
$$クレア$$
「Across a long span of time, the $$堕天翅$$ race
　is revived and falls upon humanity as a great darkness」

stage0083_03:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「That's the war from 12,000 years ago...」

stage0083_03:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$クレア$$
「But the people had not forgotten
　the legend that had saved them」

stage0083_03:r_ffee8be5e866ae97.text:
$$クレア$$
「Guided by legend, the people unearthed
　an ancient Mechanical Angel and rose up」

stage0083_03:r_bc2050dd9e12f5a4.text:
$$クレア$$
「In this age, in place of Apollonius,
　the one piloting Aquarion was a boy named Apollo...」

stage0083_03:r_e5de816af15aeaec.text:
$$クレア$$
「That's $$アポロン$$'s real name,
　from '《$$アクエリアの舞う空$$》'」

stage0083_03:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$アマタ$$
（Then, $$ミコノ$$, who $$カグラ$$ calls $$シルフィ$$...）

stage0083_03:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（And that guy $$カグラ$$, who calls
　$$ミコノ$$ '$$シルフィ$$'... he must be $$アポロン$$'s...）

stage0083_03:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$$クレア$$
「$$アポロン$$ was the reincarnated form of
　Polon, the wing dog」

stage0083_03:r_1a6f62daa82363ae.text:
$$アンディ$$
「The legendary $$アポロン$$'s past life was...!」

stage0083_03:r_6b6dd25816c18fc5.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「A wing dog, of all things...!」

stage0083_03:r_9d80dc88f241858b.text:
$$クレア$$
「And Celiane, the one he loved, had also
　been reborn, as Silvia」

stage0083_03:r_60cd511150394b50.text:
$$クレア$$
「Apollo and Silvia met again by a
　strange twist of fate, and grew closer
　to each other through the fighting」

stage0083_03:r_33e42009af9a0b54.text:
$$クレア$$
「But fate can be cruel...
　$$頭翅$$ of the $$堕天翅$$ race had also
　achieved reincarnation into this age」

stage0083_03:r_7fc1d3642481712b.text:
$$クレア$$
「$$頭翅$$, carrying over that same love and hatred,
　plotted to destroy the humanity that
　Apollonius had fought to protect」

stage0083_03:r_f72b6d47f9645d8c.text:
$$クレア$$
「But his twisted love ended up
　destroying the $$堕天翅$$ race instead」

stage0083_03:r_0153901fe839b497.text:
$$クレア$$
「The Tree of Life, planted for the $$堕天翅$$
　race's full revival, bore no fruit, and
　withered, dragging this world's land down with it」

stage0083_03:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$クレア$$
「Once, answering the people's prayers, the land
　regained its power. But a cruel
　messenger of god put it at risk again」

stage0083_03:r_336f0b1ef99d93b3.text:
$$クレア$$
「That is what is called the $$新世時空震動$$」

stage0083_03:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$カイエン$$
「The $$時空震動$$ that birthed this world...」

stage0083_03:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
$$クレア$$
「Instead of sealing this world inside
　the Prison of Time, it tried to drain
　the life of Earth across many worlds」

stage0083_03:r_f4f785c3e285cb39.text:
$$クレア$$
「To save our world from that crisis,
　Aquarion united the power of humans
　and the Wings, and sacrificed itself」

stage0083_03:r_1a9f38456bfe7b4a.text:
$$クレア$$
「Ah, poor Polon, the wing dog...
　unable to fulfill the wish he made
　12,000 years ago, he faced parting once again」

stage0083_03:r_6f761a8fd9d1f7b4.text:
$$クレア$$
「That was the day the world began...」

stage0083_03:r_98c6e74747c3936c.text:
$$不動$$
「The myth crosses another 12,000 years,
　into its third chapter...」

stage0083_03:r_60e4d2ebcfd943ea.text:
$$不動$$
「But first, you all need to know what effect
　the $$新世時空震動$$ had on
　the world we came from」

stage0083_03:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$不動$$
「The $$新世時空震動$$ affected that world
　12,000 years ago, by our history's reckoning」

stage0083_03:r_0866340ed1139b99.text:
$$クレア$$
「Our world was saved by Aquarion's power,
　but the effect was not a small one」

stage0083_03:r_290faeefba2fe68d.text:
$$クレア$$
「The world's balance collapsed, and Earth split in two」

stage0083_03:r_03d92655c99f7c70.text:
$$不動$$
「Light and dark, yin and yang, man and woman...
　Two opposing stars, kept apart by
　the Milky Way: the Weaver and the Herdsman」

stage0083_03:r_8ca795c4c35fc911.text:
$$不動$$
「Vega and Altair...
　in other words, our Earth, and the Earth
　beyond the dimensional gate...」

stage0083_03:r_d9ad0726bf16dd92.text:
$$アマタ$$
「To think they were originally one...!」

stage0083_03:r_821a93f3f890d905.text:
$$不動$$
「A gift of God's dice game, or perhaps
　quantum entanglement... Though torn apart,
　the two worlds are still drawn to each other」

stage0083_03:r_8cb00be7cca91c45.text:
$$不動$$
「A star split in half, a soul torn apart...
　This is the 'Book of Twin Stars'!」

stage0083_03:r_ce4ee5d4d2a4dc1d.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
（Just like how I long for $$アマタ$$,
　that world must have longed for ours too...）

stage0083_03:r_5557ccda2f7c3f23.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Stars drawn to each other, huh...」

stage0083_03:r_01fea60fea66c996.text:
$$不動$$
「Time flowed on. Polon, passing through Apollo,
